items.title: Roger Kellaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Gary George is my new manager

ctx.x: That she even knew the word, right?

Yeah. And I said, in my arrogance, okay, moveable do or fixed do? She said moveable do. I said great, okay. So I mean I hadn’t even thought about solfege in probably 30 years. So we’re doing all the chromatics and everything and I’m teaching her the lines to solfege. And wow, it was great. And she sung beautifully. So that’s the duet. That will probably be AM crossover. So there’s that and the new cello quartet project and I’m taking on a new agent for film and Gary George is my new manager and he’s someone that…

Is the Los Angeles music scene for you — I’m not sure how to say this. We always hear about the rat race and it’s who you know, and all that kind of — extraneous to the music. Do you have to partake in that?
